name: eval-builder
description: Build, run, and review evaluations for your own GenAI workload (agent, RAG, chatbot, tool calling, coding assistant, IDP) using the AWS GenAI Evaluations Workshop's failure-first, binary pass/fail approach.

interface.shortDescription: Build and review evals for your GenAI app
interface.longDescription: Inspects your repository, samples real outputs to find what is failing, maps failures to the AWS GenAI Evaluations Workshop modules, and after your approval scaffolds binary pass/fail judges under evals/ and an HTML report. Review mode grades existing evals against the workshop's practices.
defaultPrompt: What is failing in my agent?
